title: AVP, Security Tools Engineering
description:
**Title/Role - AVP, Security Tools Engineering (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview:**
This role belongs to the Endpoint Security Engineering organization within the Information Security function.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose:**
This role will be part of an enterprise-wide information security operations team responsible for the Synchrony Financial (SYF) Endpoint Security operations. The ideal candidate will design, implement, and maintain endpoint security solutions while monitoring, analyzing, and responding to security incidents. The candidate will provide Level 3-4 support while setting priorities and managing day-to-day operations across an enterprise team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administration of security tool’s infrastructure and support enterprise information security operations
* Develop and implement security policies and procedure to ensure data security and compliance in line with financial industry/sector standards
* Working experience in various encryption tools and technologies
* Work with vendors of security tools for support and enhancements
* Lead the design, implementation, and support of security tool enhancements
* Lead the definition/implementation of POCs (Proof of Concept) of security tools
* Manage enterprise-wide security tool monitoring mechanisms
* Prepare audit and compliance evidence/reports, lead, recommend and support solutions for requirements (i.e., GLBA, PCI, SB1386, SOX)
* Ensure expectations are met and ensure high customer satisfaction levels through established metrics against SLAs (Service Level Agreements)
* Benchmark and implement encryption/security best practices to mitigate potential threats to Synchrony's ecosystem, digital infrastructure, and operations
* Support the design and implementation of procedures and controls necessary to ensure and protect the safety and security of information systems assets, including prevention of intentional or inadvertent access, modification, disclosure, or destruction
* Understand business objectives, priorities, drivers, and technology focus areas
* As needed, act as a member of rapid response security operations/project support team, working under demanding deadlines, operating as team member as well as independently to resolve complex problems
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Hands-on experience with endpoint protection platforms like Endpoint encryption, File Scanning, Insider Risk Platforms, etc
* Expertise in deploying security solutions
* Proficiency in configuration and managing endpoint security tools
* Strong Ability to diagnose and resolve complex endpoint security issues
* Experience with change and incident management methodologies
* Experience working hybrid and multi-cloud (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) environments
* Competency in using scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python or Bash for automating security tasks and developing custom tools
* Effective in documenting processes, reporting incidents, and collaborating with technical and non-technical teams
* Demonstrated experience coordinating and supporting complex enterprise projects, including endpoint security tools deployment, enhancements, integrations, and upgrades

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Knowledge of industry regulations like PCI-DSS, HIPPA, GDPR, and how they apply to endpoint security
* Related information security certifications: CompTIA, ISACA, ISC2
* Strong analytical skills to perform problem solving, research opportunities / solutions

**Eligibility Criteria**

* A total of 5+ years of Information Security experience with a minimum of 3 years of operational experience implementing, and managing/supporting endpoint security tool platforms
* 4+ years of technical expertise in management of enterprise security tools
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in endpoint encryption technologies
* 3+ years’ experience with Windows, Linux, & Mac Operating systems

**Work Timings:**
4:00 pm to01:00 am IST
  
  
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details

title: Senior Information Technology Administrator
description:
**Company Description**
Cloud is Good (CiG) helps businesses unlock the full potential of the cloud in a secure, efficient, and cost-effective way. The company specializes in cloud migration and optimization across AWS, Azure, and GCP, security and compliance readiness, and DevOps and automation to accelerate innovation. CiG also provides collaboration tools licensing and support, AI-driven cost intelligence, and managed services including 24/7 monitoring and Kubernetes management. With 99.98% uptime, transparent pricing, and a global client base, CiG enables secure, scalable, and future-ready cloud solutions. The company is based in New Delhi and serves clients worldwide.

**Role Description**
The Senior Information Technology Administrator is a full-time hybrid role based in Gurugram, with flexibility for some work from home. This role oversees day-to-day IT operations, including server and system administration, network configuration and monitoring, and user support across cloud and on-premises environments. Responsibilities include diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues, maintaining security and compliance standards, managing backups and disaster recovery processes, and optimizing infrastructure performance. The role also involves collaborating with cloud architects and DevOps teams, documenting procedures, implementing best practices, and mentoring junior IT staff to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable IT services.

**Qualifications**

* Information Technology and System Administration skills to manage servers, operating systems, and enterprise applications.
* Network Administration and Troubleshooting skills to configure, monitor, and secure LAN/WAN, VPNs, and firewalls.
* Technical Support skills to provide advanced user support, incident resolution, and root cause analysis.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V).
* Strong understanding of security best practices, identity and access management, and compliance frameworks.
* Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and ticketing tools, and ability to create clear technical documentation.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in a hybrid environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field; relevant certifications (e.g., CCNA, MCSE, AWS/Azure admin) are a plus.

title: Assoc. Manager, IT Security
description:
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain automated security workflows that ingest, enrich, deduplicate, prioritize, and respond to alerts generated by SIEM platforms and related detection technologies.
* Engineer automated triage and response logic that reduces manual analyst effort, improves alert quality, and accelerates incident response across Security Operations.
* Build integrations between security platforms and ticketing / case management systems to enable consistent case creation, enrichment, evidence capture, escalation, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Integrate threat intelligence, asset context, identity signals, vulnerability data, and other enrichment sources into automated detection and response pipelines to support risk-based decision-making.
* Lead automation for detection and rule lifecycle management, including tuning, validation, deployment, rollback planning, measurement, and continuous improvement of security use cases.
* Partner with Security Services subject matter experts to translate operational pain points, incident response requirements, and detection engineering needs into scalable automation.
* Develop and maintain reusable scripts, API integrations, workflow components, libraries, and runbook patterns that improve automation consistency and reduce duplicate engineering effort.
* Define and apply automation standards for code quality, peer review, version control, testing, documentation, change management, and operational supportability.
* Monitor production automation health, investigate failed or degraded workflows, and improve resiliency, observability, exception handling, and alerting for mission-critical automation services.
* Evaluate emerging cyber threats and operational trends, then implement or improve automated coverage through new detections, enrichments, response actions, or reporting capabilities.
* Lead smaller automation projects or defined phases of broader Security Operations initiatives, coordinating tasks, dependencies, testing, implementation, and handoff with cross-functional partners.
* Mentor junior engineers or analysts on automation patterns, troubleshooting, secure coding practices, workflow design, and platform best practices.
* Maintain accurate runbooks, workflow documentation, architecture notes, operational handoff materials, and evidence required for audits, change reviews, or leadership reporting.
* Participate in on-call or critical incident support for high-impact automation services as required by the Security Operations support model.

**Required Skills**

* Strong programming and scripting capability in Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or similar languages, with experience building reliable automation for security operations use cases.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM and SOAR platforms, detection logic, alert enrichment, automated playbooks, workflow orchestration, and downstream response integrations.
* Strong understanding of SOC operations, incident response workflows, detection engineering, security telemetry, alert lifecycle, triage patterns, and case handling processes.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven integrations, and data exchange patterns across security tools, cloud services, and internal platforms.
* Working knowledge of threat frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, or similar models, with the ability to operationalize them through automation and detection use cases.
* Understanding of network protocols, endpoint telemetry, identity signals, cloud security controls, vulnerability data, and other security context used for enrichment and response.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, code review, test automation, release documentation, and configuration management practices for production automation.
* Ability to independently analyze complex technical problems, evaluate trade-offs, and choose practical methods for reliable, supportable security automation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical automation design, operational impact, limitations, and risk-based recommendations to security and IT stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* 10-12 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, security engineering, detection engineering, incident response, or security automation roles.
* At least 10 years of experience operating within a SOC or enterprise security environment, with direct exposure to detection engineering, incident response workflows, and security tooling automation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Demonstrated experience creating or significantly improving automation workflows, security integrations, rule lifecycle processes, response playbooks, or operational tools in a production environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance on complex assignments and act as a technical resource for less experienced engineers or analysts.
* Experience collaborating across security, engineering, IT, cloud, platform, and vendor teams in a global or distributed enterprise environment.
* Proficient in written and spoken English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with SOAR platforms and workflow orchestration tools, including development of automated playbooks, integrations, enrichment workflows, and response actions.
* Experience automating security controls and response actions across AWS, Azure, GCP, or hybrid cloud environments.
* Exposure to infrastructure as code or configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies for repeatable security automation.
* Knowledge of modern detection engineering practices, including use case development, false positive reduction, enrichment strategies, coverage mapping, and telemetry quality improvement.
* Experience with security automation reliability practices, including monitoring, retry logic, queue handling, error handling, performance tuning, and failure analysis.
* Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, cloud security certifications, or security automation-related credentials are a plus.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
KPIs are intended to guide measurable performance expectations and may be refined based on platform ownership, automation maturity, Security Operations priorities, and business-critical use cases.
  
  
Short-Term Outcomes (3-6 Months)
  
  
  

* Onboarding and environment fluency: Complete onboarding to Yum!’s Security Operations platforms, priority workflows, critical integrations, change processes, and stakeholder map within 90 days.
* Automation baseline: Establish or update an inventory of assigned automations, dependencies, owners, health status, runbooks, and known gaps within the first 90 days.
* Workflow delivery: Deliver at least 2-3 approved automation enhancements, playbooks, integrations, or workflow improvements in the first 3-6 months, with documented acceptance criteria and operational handoff.
* Change quality: Ensure at least 95% of assigned automation changes include version control, peer review, testing evidence, rollback guidance, and runbook updates.
* Operational responsiveness: Triage high-priority automation failures, degraded workflows, or production support requests within agreed SLAs and communicate impact, workaround, and remediation status clearly.
* Efficiency improvement: Reduce manual steps or average enrichment time by 10-15% for at least one prioritized alert, triage, or response workflow.

Long-Term Outcomes (6-12+ Months)
  
  
  

* MTTA / MTTR improvement: Improve mean time to acknowledge, enrich, or respond for targeted security use cases by at least 20% through validated automation.
* Manual effort reduction: Reduce repeatable manual Security Operations effort by 25-30% across prioritized workflows through automation, enrichment, auto-ticketing, or response orchestration.
* Detection and response quality: Improve false positive handling, enrichment quality, or alert disposition accuracy by 15-20% for selected high-volume or high-risk use cases.
* Automation reliability: Maintain at least 99% availability or successful execution for business-critical automation workflows, excluding approved maintenance windows or dependent-platform outages.
* Lifecycle maturity: Implement or materially improve rule lifecycle, playbook lifecycle, code review, deployment, monitoring, and rollback practices for assigned automation services.
* Knowledge transfer: Mentor junior analysts or engineers through documented patterns, code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and reusable automation templates.

Functional KPI Categories
  
  
**Technical Delivery**

* Number of production-ready playbooks, integrations, scripts, or reusable workflow components delivered against agreed backlog priorities.
* Percentage of delivered automations with documented acceptance criteria, test evidence, error handling, rollback instructions, and operational handoff.
* Adherence to coding, change management, peer review, version control, and documentation standards.

**Operational Efficiency**

* Reduction in manual analyst steps, duplicate ticket handling, repetitive enrichment tasks, and avoidable escalations.
* Increase in percentage of alerts that are automatically enriched, routed, ticketed, suppressed, or escalated according to approved logic.
* Improvement in analyst feedback scores or stakeholder satisfaction for automated workflows and runbooks.

**Detection, Response & Risk Reduction**

* Improvement in coverage for prioritized threat scenarios, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, or high-risk detection use cases through automation.
* Speed of deploying validated automation updates for urgent threats, new detections, or critical operational gaps.
* Measured improvement in quality of evidence, severity assignment, ownership, and remediation tracking for automation-generated tickets.

**Reliability, Governance & Leadership**

* Production automation success rate, failure rate, recovery time, and repeat-incident trend for assigned workflows.
* Number and quality of code reviews, design reviews, runbook reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions delivered for peers or junior team members.
* Timely reporting of automation outcomes, risks, technical debt, dependencies, and roadmap recommendations to Security Operations leadership.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or related field with 8-10 years of relevant experience

title: Techincal Manager (Civil) - Design & DPR (Highways/Railways)
description:
Techincal Project Manager (Civil)
  

**Job Title:**
Operations Manager
**Experience:**
3–6 years (minimum 1 year in project management)
**Location:**
Gurugram / Delhi NCR (Work from Office, with project site travel)
**Employment Type:**
Full Time, Permanent
**Function:**
Operations / Project Management
**Industry:**
Drone Survey, Geospatial & Infrastructure Services

About the Role

DATAPKT delivers drone-based survey, photogrammetry, GIS and inspection services for railway, highway and infrastructure projects across India. We are looking for an Operations Manager, a Civil Engineer with design and geospatial experience, to run our project operations end to end: from tender and planning through field execution, data processing, design deliverables and client handover.

Key Responsibilities

* **Project Management:**
  Plan, schedule and track multiple concurrent projects; own timelines, resources, budgets and client milestones from mobilisation to closure.
* **Drone Survey Operations:**
  Plan and supervise drone missions (topographic surveys, aerial videography, thermography, progress monitoring); coordinate pilots, equipment and DGCA / Digital Sky compliance.
* **Photogrammetry & GIS:**
  Oversee data processing (orthomosaics, DSM/DTM, point clouds, contours) and GIS mapping; ensure accuracy, GCP control and QA/QC of all outputs.
* **DPR & Design Deliverables:**
  Lead preparation of Detailed Project Reports (DPRs), feasibility and survey reports; prepare and review General Arrangement Drawings (GADs), plan & profile / L-sections, cross-sections, alignment drawings, land plans and quantity estimates for highway and railway projects.
* **Civil Design & Engineering:**
  Review and support design of highway and railway alignments, junctions, structures and drainage using survey data; ensure compliance with IRC, MoRTH and RDSO standards.
* **Client & Stakeholder Coordination:**
  Act as the main point of contact for clients, consultants and site authorities (railways, NHAI/PWD, PSUs); attend review meetings, present progress and get drawings/DPRs approved.
* **Tenders & Documentation:**
  Support preparation of technical bids, methodologies, BOQs and project reports; maintain project documentation and billing inputs.
* **Team Leadership:**
  Lead and mentor field surveyors, drone pilots and GIS/CAD analysts; allocate work and maintain quality and safety standards.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Standardise SOPs, track field expenses and work-done records, and improve operational efficiency.

Requirements

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering (M.Tech in Transportation, Geomatics or Remote Sensing/GIS is a plus)
* 3–6 years of experience, including minimum 1 year of project management on highway, railway or infrastructure projects
* Proven experience in DPR preparation and GAD / design drawings for highway or railway projects
* Hands-on experience with drone surveys and photogrammetry workflows
* Working knowledge of GIS and design software: AutoCAD / Civil 3D, MX Road / OpenRoads, ArcGIS / QGIS, Pix4D / Agisoft Metashape / DJI Terra (any)
* Understanding of highway and railway design standards (IRC, MoRTH, RDSO / Indian Railways codes)
* Strong communication, client-handling and team-coordination skills
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Project or equivalent planning tools
* Willingness to travel to project sites
* DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate is an added advantage

Key Skills

Operations Management, Project Management, Civil Engineering, DPR Preparation, GAD, Highway Design, Railway Projects, Plan & Profile, Cross Sections, Drone Survey, UAV, Photogrammetry, GIS, ArcGIS, QGIS, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, MX Road, Pix4D, Agisoft Metashape, Topographic Survey, DGPS, Client Coordination, Tender Documentation

title: Senior Network Operations Engineer
description:
**The Role**

The Senior Network Operations Engineer is responsible for the deployment, operations, and continuous improvement of Megaport’s global network infrastructure. This role plays a critical part in building, expanding, and maintaining highly scalable, reliable, and resilient network services that customers depend on.

Working closely with Network Architects, Infrastructure, and Customer Support teams, you will contribute to expanding the global network footprint, increasing capacity, and ensuring operational excellence across the infrastructure.

This role requires strong expertise in large-scale network deployments, network operations, and troubleshooting, with a focus on automation, performance optimisation, and customer experience.

To be eligible for this position, you must be able to work from our Gurugram office immediately and have a maximum notice period of 30 days.

You will collaborate with global stakeholders, data centre providers, and carriers to deliver new infrastructure, resolve complex network challenges, and maintain high network availability.

**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 400 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design, analyse, test, and deploy new network sites and infrastructure.
* Plan and execute network deployments and upgrades.
* Plan and execute data centre onboarding, PoP deployments, and network equipment installations.
* Configure and deploy enterprise networking equipment (Cisco and Juniper) via secure remote methods.
* Design, implement, and test Cloud On-Ramp connectivity with providers such as AWS, Azure, and Oracle.
* Design, implement, and validate global network circuits.
* Operate and maintain the next-generation global network infrastructure.
* Provide Level 3 escalation support for major network incidents and customer-impacting issues.
* Support Network Operations Centre (NOC) teams during incident mitigation and troubleshooting.
* Identify the root causes of network issues and implement preventive measures.
* Document operational procedures and completed work in internal systems.
* Actively monitor, plan and execute network capacity management initiatives.
* Support network risk management and resilience improvements.
* Identify opportunities to redesign the network to optimise performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Execute assigned procurement activities to ensure adherence to network design standards.
* Perform carrier and vendor technical analysis.
* Manage assigned network deployment and infrastructure projects end-to-end.
* Coordinate with engineering, deployment, and operations teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Provide regular reporting on network performance, deployments, and infrastructure growth.
* Contribute to technical documentation, SOPs, and operational processes.
* Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and operations teams.
* Contribute to the development of training materials for Network Operations staff.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex infrastructure issues.
* Work closely with other departments across Megaport (e.g., Network/Infrastructure, Engineering, Procurement/Suppliers as relevant) to achieve shared business goals.
* Enhance integration between Megaport teams to reduce resolution times, enhance accountability, and improve customer outcomes.
* Advocate for the customer internally by turning feedback and recurring issues into clear, prioritised improvement initiatives.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **6+ years of experience**
  working with large-scale network deployments and operations
* Strong experience with routing and MPLS technologies, including
  **BGP, ISIS, MPLS Traffic Engineering, and MPLS L2/L3 VPN**
* Production experience with
  **Juniper and Cisco**
  network platforms
* Experience deploying and troubleshooting data centre network infrastructure
* Experience working with fibre optic technologies and
  **DWDM environments**
* Familiarity with cloud networking and SDN concepts
* Experience with Python, Perl, Linux environments or similar scripting languages is highly desirable
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
* Ability to work independently and across distributed teams
* Proactive and self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset
* Strong focus on delivering an excellent customer experience

**Team Fit**

* Able to work autonomously within a globally dispersed team environment, managing competing priorities with minimal supervision.
* Strong work ethic, reliable follow-through, and consistent accountability for outcomes.
* Team player who enjoys collaboration, contributes ideas, and is comfortable mentoring and coaching others.
* Passion for innovation and technology, with an interest in staying current across evolving ISP and cloud landscapes.
* Planning & Project Delivery
* Strong organisation and prioritisation skills; effectively plans and manages workload in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Exposure to running projects effectively is essential (driving initiatives across process, tooling, reporting, service improvements, or training uplift).

**What We Offer**

* \*Subject to the internal policies of Megaport, which may be updated from time to time\*:
* Family health insurance according to complany policy
* A motivated team combining industry experts and emerging talent.
* Recognition programs – including Legend and Kudos Awards.
* Health & wellness programs and mental well-being support.

**Working Conditions, Location and Hours**

* Full-time office-based role, at our Gurugram office
* The working day is 8 hours, and the working week is 40 hours.
* Working visits to the Locations which are under your responsibility for meeting partners, vendors, team, checking the quality of the network
* 90-day notice period for resignation after the trial period
* Working exclusively for Extreme Infocom Pvt. Ltd. and not for any other companies.

If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at Careers@megaport.com

**NOTE:
*All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team careers@megaport.com directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".***

*All applications will be treated in confidence.*

*Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. Note that you’re entitled to know what personal data of yours Megaport holds, to request updates, rectification, and in some circumstances restriction or deletion thereof if you object (you being entitled to withdraw your consent to our holding your information at any time). Please see Part 5 of our Privacy Policy for more details on this and how to contact Megaport's data protection officer if you have any further privacy-related questions. Candidates who meet the selection criteria will be invited to attend an interview. Strictly no Recruitment Agencies.*

*We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*

title: TC-CS-Cyber Architecture- OT and Engineering-infrastructure and Cloud Security- Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**IT Network & Infrastructure Security – Senior Manager**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead and scale the Zero Trust Security Portfolio across EY GDS. This role will be responsible for leading complex client programs, building high-performing teams, and driving innovation across Infrastructure Security capabilities.
  
  
The Senior Manager will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership, helping organizations transition from traditional security to Zero Trust Security. The role requires deep experience in cybersecurity architecture, network security, and zero trust security in cyber.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise & cloud environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in zero-trust and micro-segmentation solutions including Zscaler, Guardicore and Illumio.
* Define logical patterns & develop use cases for zero trust capabilities across Network, Identity & Access Management, Device, Application and other security domains
* Work in multiple domains of security technologies viz Network segmentation, Application gateways, security automation, Firewalls, VPN, SDN, SD-WAN, IAM solutions.
* Possess hands on experience in segmenting networks, applications, and data to limit exposure to attacks.
* Good exposure in requirement understanding, security frameworks, technical documentation, designing HLDs and LLDs.
* Well-versed in encrypting all end-to-end communication regardless of the location, authorizing access to resources on a per-session basis, enforcing the temporary and dynamic nature of authentication and authorization.
* Monitoring all assets to be in the most secure state possible and maintaining visibility into the security of the entire network and business's resources.
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of zero trust market needs/challenges and assist in the planning, design and development of go-to-market solutions.
* Understand SaaS based technologies and identity-based micro-segmentation for cloud workloads and their implications for the enterprise.
* Document or enhance documentation on zero-trust architecture requirements.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s Zero Trust, Network & Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience across Network & Infrastructure security domain, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Expertise in Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (NIST 800-207, NIST 800-53, ZT DoD, CISA ZTMM).
* Hands-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.
* Deep technical understanding of zero trust architecture and solutioning of zero trust security components.
* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for zero trust security including governance and operating models.
* Clearly demonstrates proven extensive abilities with leveraging creative thinking and problem-solving skills, individual initiative, and utilizing Office 365, MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Docs.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Engage with CISOs, CIOs, plant leadership, OT operations teams, technology leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco & others)

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Program Management, Network Infrastructure
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Strong program management experience in the networking area with experience delivering infrastructure assets and vendor management.
* Solid knowledge of fiber optic systems/submarine cable ecosystems. Solid working understanding of Asian and global carrier networks.
* Ability to exercise business and technical understanding to drive the long-term objectives of the organization.
* Strong problem solving and financial skills. Adopt data-driven, analytical approach towards solving complex challenges.
* Is proficient in navigating ambiguity and identifying opportunities for optimization whilst possessing problem-solving skills.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
  
  
The Global Network Acquisition (GNA) APAC team leads the planning, design, acquisition and long term scaling of Google's Production networks in Asia. We ensure our network can support the growth of all existing and new products and services in Asia cost efficiently and on-time.
  
  
Our responsibility includes securing and building network infrastructure, from colocation space, metro fiber, long haul networks, to submarine capacity/cables and related infrastructure across many countries in Asia.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with internal business and cross-functional networking technical teams to identify and define tactical and strategic initiatives necessary to meet Google's network infrastructure needs for both expansion and cost optimization across Asia.
* Present network plans for approval by all internal stakeholders. Plan complexity will range from short-term metro augments to long-term region-wide strategies for Google network in Asia.
* Manage the approved network plan with internal contributors such as network negotiators or vendor delivery managers to ensure infrastructure is delivered on-time.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to define and improve business processes to enable automation, reduce lead time and manage changes. Communicate progress internally and collaborate with network deployment and other technical teams.
* Partner with network negotiators in planning and execution of orders and contracts, and in vendors meetings and industry conferences.

title: Associate Vice President - Partner Network Assurance
description:
**About the role**

Excitel brings leased fibre up to the hub of each Excitel Regional Partner (ERP) or LCO. The ERP

then deploys and owns the FTTH last mile (primary and secondary splitters, drop wire) and is

responsible for its uptime, MTTR, complaint resolution and new installations.

The AVP – Partner Network Assurance owns the quality of this partner-run network across multiple

regions. The role is fully accountable for complaint ratios, MTTR and uptime, while the hands-on

work is done by ERPs and their technicians. Success comes from strong architecture and standards,

deep technical guidance and firm partner governance, not direct control.

**Key responsibilities**

**Network quality and performance**

* Own complaint ratio, MTTR, repeat complaints and uptime for all ERP networks in assigned regions.
* Set region-, cluster- and ERP-level targets; track daily and review weekly/monthly.
* Drive RCA and time-bound remediation for chronic, high-complaint ERP networks.
* Lead restoration of major and area-wide disruptions, coordinating ERPs, NOC and backbone teams.

**Architecture and deployment standards**

* Define the reference FTTH architecture: splitter ratios and topology, OLT port planning, fibre routing and redundancy.
* Set and enforce SOPs for splicing, enclosures, FAT/FDB placement, drop wire and ONU installation.
* Define optical power budgets and Rx/Tx thresholds; run periodic network health audits.
* Design solutions for new geographies, high-density clusters (MDUs, societies) and capacity upgrades.

**Partner governance and capability**

* Guide, supervise and audit ERPs and technicians to Excitel standards, without direct authority over them.
* Build partner scorecards, SLAs, escalation matrices and incentive/penalty levers.
* Run training and certification for ERP technicians; technically onboard new ERPs.

**Technical leadership and team**

* Act as senior escalation point for complex faults across OLT, ONU, MPLS switches and the optical layer, at hardware and firmware level.
* Build fault playbooks and knowledge bases from RCA learnings.
* Lead, hire and develop a large pan-regional team of Network Managers and Field Engineers.
* Work with NOC, Core Network, Customer Service, Sales and Partner Business teams; report performance to senior leadership.

**Technical competencies**

* FTTH and optical (expert): GPON/XGS-PON architecture, splitter planning, optical power budgeting and management, OTDR/power meter/splicing tools, fibre plant best practices.
* Active equipment (hardware and firmware): OLT (cards, PON ports, provisioning, VLANs, firmware), ONU/ONT (provisioning, upgrades, common failures), MPLS/aggregation switches (L2/L3, MPLS, redundancy).
* Multi-vendor exposure preferred (e.g., Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, Syrotech, V-SOL, Cisco, Juniper).
* Operations: NMS/EMS and ticketing tools, structured RCA, SOP creation, dashboards and data-driven reviews.

**Experience and qualifications**

* 10–15 years in broadband, ISP, telecom or cable operations with deep FTTH exposure.
* Proven experience working directly with LCOs or partner networks on quality, uptime and complaint resolution.
* 5+ years leading large, multi-state field and network teams; track record of reducing complaint ratios and MTTR at scale.
* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Telecom, Electrical or Computer Science; FTTH/PON or networking certifications (CCNA/CCNP, JNCIA) are a plus.

+ Breaker failure protection
+ Feeder protection
+ Capacitor bank and reactor protection

+ Trip and alarm matrix

+ Cable schedules

+ Test and commissioning documentation

* Provide expert review of relay setting calculations and protection coordination studies.

* Provide technical direction for distance protection, differential protection, overcurrent protection, earth fault protection, REF, synchro-check, auto-reclose, breaker failure and busbar protection applications.
* Support fault level studies, protection grading, grid code compliance and system performance validation.
* Provide technical support during FAT, SAT, commissioning, energization and post-energization troubleshooting.

**IEC 61850 Integration and Digital Substations**

+ Station bus
+ Process bus
+ Protection IEDs
+ Merging units
+ SCADA gateways
+ HMI systems

+ Network switches

+ GOOSE messaging
+ MMS communication
+ Sampled Values
+ Logical nodes and data modelling
+ Dataset configuration

+ Sampled Value control blocks
+ Multi-vendor interoperability

+ IEC 61850 architecture drawings

+ Signal lists and data point schedules
+ GOOSE mapping schedules
+ MMS mapping schedules

title: Staff/ Snr Lead Engineer, Edge
description:
**What the role is all about:**

We’re seeking a Staff Engineer - EDGE Platform who will play a pivotal role in shaping and scaling REA’s edge security and content delivery capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, cloud, networking and security, with a strong focus on building resilient, reusable and well-governed edge platform capabilities for teams across REA.

You’ll help define and evolve our EDGE platform strategy across CDN, WAF, bot management, DNS and traffic management, while applying platform thinking to create paved-road solutions that are secure, scalable and simple for product and engineering teams to adopt. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with operational discipline, leveraging automation, observability and incident response practices to improve reliability and customer outcomes.

This is your chance to work on impactful projects that directly influence availability, performance and security for customer-facing experiences at scale. You’ll work with modern tooling and collaborate with engineers across infrastructure, security and product teams in a large, complex technology environment.

**While no two days are likely to be the same, your typical responsibilities will include:**

* Set technical direction for the EDGE platform across CDN, WAF, DDoS protection, bot management, DNS and traffic management, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable and aligned to business priorities.
* Lead the design and evolution of platform capabilities using Akamai and Kasada, making sound architectural decisions that balance security, reliability, performance and developer experience.
* Define and drive reusable platform patterns using Terraform, with strong platform thinking that enables self-service, consistency, governance and safe adoption across engineering teams.
* Work across AWS, networking, CDN and edge security domains to solve complex end-to-end problems and raise the technical maturity of internet-facing systems.
* Partner closely with product, platform, security and development teams to influence roadmaps, shape designs early and ensure edge capabilities are built as strategic platform services rather than one-off solutions.
* Improve operational excellence through PagerDuty, incident leadership, runbooks, on-call practices, service readiness reviews and clear ownership models.
* Define technical standards, guardrails and engineering best practices for the EDGE domain, and ensure they are adopted effectively across teams.
* Own and drive meaningful technology outcomes through OKRs, architecture direction and measurable improvements in security, reliability, performance and platform adoption.
* Mentor engineers, provide technical leadership across team boundaries and help grow a strong engineering culture centred on accountability, ownership and continuous improvement.

**Who we’re looking for:**

* 9+ years’ experience in cloud platform, SRE, network and edge engineering roles, including strong hands-on delivery and technical leadership in production environments.
* Deep expertise in CDN and edge technologies, ideally including Akamai for CDN, WAF and DDoS protection, with the ability to make sound architectural and operational trade-offs.
* Strong experience with bot management platforms such as Kasada, or similar capabilities used to detect and mitigate automated abuse at scale.
* Strong depth in AWS and a broad understanding of networking, DNS, TLS, traffic routing and internet-facing architectures, with the ability to reason across the full request path.
* Advanced proficiency in Terraform and infrastructure as code, including designing reusable modules, standards, abstractions and governance mechanisms for wider engineering adoption.
* Strong software engineering skills in Python and/or Go, with experience building internal tooling, automation and platform integrations used by multiple teams.
* Proven ability to solve ambiguous, high-impact technical problems across distributed systems and drive outcomes that improve security, reliability, performance and developer experience.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, product, security and leadership stakeholders with varying technical backgrounds.
* A high degree of accountability and ownership, including experience shaping or owning OKRs, driving execution and being responsible for measurable platform outcomes.

**Bonus Points for:**

* Experience designing internal platform capabilities that improve developer experience and adoption through self-service patterns.
* Exposure to edge security policy management, rate limiting, API protection or zero trust patterns.
* Experience in high-scale internet platforms where performance, availability and abuse prevention are critical.
* Familiarity with compliance, governance or risk controls in cloud and edge environments.

**What we offer:**

* A hybrid and flexible approach to working.
* Transport options to help you get to and from work, including home pick-up and drop-off.
* Meals provided on site in our office.
* Flexible leave options including parental leave, family care leave and celebration leave.
* Insurances for you and your immediate family members.
* Programs to support mental, emotional, financial and physical health & wellbeing.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities to further your technical expertise.

title: Principal Architect - Performance Engineering
description:
**About Snapmint**

Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India’s most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India’s leading 0% EMI e-commerce app — giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with noextra cost and no credit card required.Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2,000+ leadingconsumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We’re on a mission to makefair, transparent credit accessible to Young India - and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry-free.Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi andJaipur, we’re building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on aproduct used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of Indiapays and spends you’ll fit right in.Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays.

**The Role**

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Architect – Performance Engineering to drive performance engineering initiatives across the application, database, infrastructure, and network layers. The role requires deep expertise in diagnosing bottlenecks, optimizing system performance, and building scalable architectures capable of supporting high transaction volumes and rapid business growth.This is not a purely advisory architecture role. You will be expected to lead and, where required, independently execute performance improvements end-to-end.

**Role Details**

* Role Title: Principal Engineer / Architect – Performance Engineering
* Department: Technology
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Experience: 10-15 Years
* Location: Gurugram
* Working Model: Work from Office – 5 Days per Week

**What You Own**

Performance Engineering

* Own end-to-end performance of critical systems across latency, throughput, concurrency, scalability,and resource utilization.
* Diagnose complex performance bottlenecks using profiling, benchmarking, load testing, distributedtracing, and system-level analysis.
* Identify performance issues across application code, runtime, databases, network, and infrastructure,and drive them to resolution.
* Establish performance engineering practices covering capacity planning, performance testing,profiling, and production optimization.
* Partner with engineering teams to design systems that scale predictably under increasing load.

Infrastructure, Database & Network Optimization

* Optimize compute, memory, storage, networking, and cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Tune PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and other data systems through query optimization, indexing, schema design, caching, connection management, and capacity planning.
* Analyse network behaviour including DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, connection pooling, load balancing, routing, and payload optimization.
* Investigate production incidents and perform deep root-cause analysis across the full technology stack.
* Build and improve observability required to understand system behaviour and proactively identify performance degradation.

Infrastructure & Operational Excellence Architecture & Technical Leadership

* Define architectural patterns and engineering standards for high-performance distributed systems.
* Identify systemic performance problems across services and drive cross-team remediation.
* Work closely with Backend, Platform, DevOps, SRE, and Data teams on high-impact performance initiatives.
* Establish measurable performance goals and use data to validate improvements.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in Performance Engineering, Platform Engineering, Backend Engineering, or Solution Architecture.

**What You Bring**

* Deep expertise in application performance tuning and distributed systems.
* Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and caching technologies.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts including DNS, connection pooling, compression, load balancing, TCP/IP, and HTTP protocols.
* Experience with performance testing and observability tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, Prometheus,Grafana, Datadog, or similar.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proven track record of solving large-scale performance bottlenecks.

**Why Snapmint**

* Be Part of a 10X–100X Journey - Help build and scale and be part of a high-growth story.
* Raise the Bar - Learn from people who raise the bar.
* Solve Hard Problems - Work on meaningful, high-impact challenges.
* Own the Outcome - Take ownership and make things happen.
* Move Fast, Build Fast - Turn ideas into action, not backlogs.
* Make Real Impact - See your work reach millions of customers.
* Grow with Snapmint - Take on bigger challenges as we scale.

**Explore Snapmint**

• Meet The Founders - Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa

• Life at Snapmint - https://www.linkedin.com/company/snapmintfinserv/life

• Behind the Build: The Snapmint Story - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M3vRIxfa7tc

• Business Case Studies - https://www.snapmintbusiness.com/case-studies

title: Director
description:
**Director Platform Engineer**

The client is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through a unified suite covering ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX).

The client is evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through its AI-powered platform.

**Role Summary**

The Director Platform runs the current infrastructure while building the target platform. This is an operating role and a transformation role.

The role keeps existing SaaS environments stable, builds the new cloud-native platform, owns the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline, establishes the security practice, and brings platform engineering discipline into the way teams ship.

**What This Role Owns**

* Current SaaS infrastructure stability.
* Target cloud-native platform architecture and operations.
* Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD platform foundations.
* Oracle to Postgres migration tooling, validation, rollback, and cutover support.
* Platform SLOs, incident response, on-call model, and environment controls.
* Security, network, access, secrets, WAF, and compliance readiness.
* DBA practice across Oracle legacy operations and PostgreSQL target operations.
* Platform team structure, hiring, standards, and capability building.

**What This Role Does Not Own**

* Product roadmap or commercial prioritization.
* Domain business rules owned by Supply Chain, Core Commerce, or Digital Commerce.
* Architecture authority for bounded contexts, which sits with the Chief Architect and Technical Design Council.
* Program status governance, which sits with the Transformation Program Lead.
* Embedded engineering delivery inside domain squads.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Operations**

* Own infrastructure across current and target environments.
* Define and operate platform SLOs.
* Manage environment provisioning, access, capacity, and decommissioning.
* Reduce cloud waste through shared infrastructure, capacity discipline, and retention controls.

**Target Platform**

* Build the shared platform foundation for Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD.
* Establish standards for deployments, secrets, networking, monitoring, tracing, and release automation.
* Make platform capabilities usable by domain teams without each team having to invent its own tooling.

**Migration Engineering**

* Own the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline with the migration engineering team.
* Define migration throughput, data validation, rollback readiness, and post-migration checks.
* Work with domain teams and Principal QA on parity, shadow, pilot, and cutover readiness.

**Security And Reliability**

* Build the security practice and baseline controls.
* Establish incident response, on-call, alerting, and production review practices.
* Drive SOC2 / ISO 27001 readiness where needed.

**Team Building**

* Lead a distributed platform organization across infrastructure, DBA, security, DevOps/SRE, internal IT, and migration engineering.
* Hire senior platform, security, SRE, and DevOps talent where the current team has gaps.
* Grow junior engineers into a disciplined platform practice.

**Required Experience**

* 15+ years in
  **infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, database operations, or cloud operations.**
* Experience leading teams of meaningful size and mixed seniority.
* Deep experience in at least two of Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS, Kafka, observability, or security operations.
* Experience running production systems while modernizing them.
* Strong understanding of multi-tenant SaaS operations, access control, reliability, and incident management.
* Hands-on comfort with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD tooling.

**Helpful Experience**

* Oracle to Postgres migration experience.
* Retail, ERP, POS, OMS, or e-commerce platform experience.
* Experience building a platform team from an early stage.
* Familiarity with .NET, Java/Spring Boot, and mixed-stack modernization.
* Compliance exposure, including ISO 27001, SOC2, penetration testing, or security audits.

* Task Force and BCs technical support.
* Emergency status updates and periodic reports.
* Executive management updates during major outages.

title: Consulting Architect - Observability
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
We are seeking an exceptional and highly experienced
**Senior Consulting Architect**
to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted technical architect and consultant, working with complex enterprise environments to translate business challenges into robust, scalable, and value-driven Elastic solutions. The role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, senior-level consulting acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones, with both remote support and required on-site client engagement.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**
As a member of our professional services team you will deliver Elastic solutions and Elastic stack expertise to drive customer business value from our products. Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end-to-end delivery of ground-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof-of-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
  
  
Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!
  
  
Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Facilitate feedback from the field back to the product. Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
  
  
**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**

* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Observability Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Minimum of 7 years as a Consulting Architect or senior IT functional leadership experience
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Observability.
* Fleet and agent installation policies, and scalability considerations.
* Knowledge in deploying enterprise observability (Metrics and Logs) solutions at scale (Application performance monitoring (APM), User experience monitoring (UEM), Infrastructure optimization, Network visibility and monitoring).
* Experience leading observability projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience working with monitoring tools that integrate into service management.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)

**Bonus Points:**

* Any cloud service provider's - Gen AI certification.
* Additional Elastic Certifications
* Comfortable with Ansible, JavaScript, Terraform
* Experience working closely with a pre-sales organization in scoping customer needs and delivering against a Statement of Work (SOW).
* Experience as a technical instructor or public speaker on enterprise infrastructure software.
* Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

!

They are responsible for diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues, installing and configuring systems, and maintaining IT infrastructure. The role involves direct interaction with end-users to address their technical concerns, deliver training, and ensure seamless operation of desktop environments. This position requires strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication abilities, and a proactive approach to maintaining the organization's IT systems. The Desktop Support Engineer plays a critical role in maintaining user productivity and satisfaction by ensuring reliable and secure access to desktop resources.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Technical Support:
  
  

* Provide first-line support for hardware, software, and network issues.
* Respond to user inquiries, troubleshoot problems, and provide solutions.
* Install, configure, and update software and hardware.

**System Maintenance**

* Perform routine maintenance on desktop environments, including software updates and hardware upgrades.
* Ensure all systems are secure and up-to-date with the latest patches and antivirus software.

**User Assistance**

* Assist users with technical issues via phone, email, or in-person.
* Provide training and guidance on new software or hardware.
* Create and maintain user accounts and permissions.

**Documentation And Reporting**

* Document all technical issues and resolutions in a ticketing system.
* Generate regular reports on system performance, issues, and resolutions.
* Maintain an inventory of all hardware and software assets.

**Network Support**

* Troubleshoot and resolve network connectivity issues.
* Assist with the setup and maintenance of local area networks (LANs) and wireless networks.

**Security**

* Implement and enforce security policies to protect data and systems.
* Monitor systems for security breaches and respond to any incidents.

**Project Participation**

* Assist in IT projects such as rollouts of new hardware or software.
* Collaborate with other IT team members on larger projects.

**Customer Service**

* Provide excellent customer service to ensure user satisfaction.
* Follow up with users to ensure issues are fully resolved.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Stay updated on the latest industry trends and technologies.
* Recommend improvements to the existing IT infrastructure.

description:

Solutions Architect

****Solution Architect****

**Nice To Have Skills**

title: Technical Support Engineer – Slurm
description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 30 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation fueled by great technology—and dynamic people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing—an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. NVIDIANs immerse themselves in a diverse, supportive environment that encourages everyone to do their best work. Join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
Slurm is a critical workload manager for many of the world’s most demanding AI and high-performance computing environments. We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer dedicated to supporting Slurm for NVIDIA’s customers. You will join a dedicated team of Slurm subject-matter guides, owning sophisticated support cases and helping customers run reliable, efficient, and highly scalable clusters. This role requires extensive production experience with Slurm and the ability to diagnose issues across the scheduler and the surrounding Linux, networking, storage, authentication, database, and GPU infrastructure.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own Slurm support cases from initial investigation through resolution for customers running production AI and HPC clusters.
* Diagnose complex problems involving slurmctld, slurmd, slurmdbd, job scheduling, node management, resource allocation, accounting, authentication, and high availability.
* Solve Slurm configuration and policy features, including partitions, reservations, priorities, fair-share, quality of service, backfill, preemption, GRES/TRES, cgroups, and job constraints.
* Investigate performance, reliability, and scalability issues using logs, diagnostic data, configuration analysis, reproductions, and source-level debugging when required.
* Isolate problems across Slurm and its surrounding dependencies, including Linux, MUNGE, databases, networking, parallel storage, containers, GPUs, and cluster-management systems.
* Advise customers on Slurm configuration, upgrades, operational practices, managing system resources, and safe recovery from production incidents.
* Collaborate with engineering teams by producing clear technical descriptions, reproducible test cases, and well-supported defect reports.
* Develop guides, knowledge-base articles, diagnostic tools, and internal training that strengthen Slurm expertise across the support organization.

**What We Need To See**

* BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience administering and supporting Slurm in production HPC or AI environments including business-critical outage incidents.
* Expert-level understanding of Slurm architecture, daemons, configuration, scheduling behavior, accounting, resource management, and failure modes.
* Capacity to identify sophisticated Slurm incidents independently and guide them to a technically sound resolution.
* In-depth Linux system-administration and solve experience, including systemd, cgroups, authentication, networking, and database-backed services.
* Experience operating Slurm across multi-user clusters with complex scheduling policies and heterogeneous compute resources.
* Strong analytical and research skills, showing proficiency in distinguishing Slurm defects from configuration, integration, infrastructure, and workload problems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn detailed technical findings into clear explanations and actionable recommendations.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience supporting large-scale Slurm environments containing thousands of nodes or GPUs.
* Experience diagnosing scheduler performance, job-throughput, controller-load, and database-scaling issues.
* Familiarity with Slurm source code, plugins, SPANK, Lua job-submit plugins, or upstream issue investigation.
* Experience with containers and HPC integration technologies such as Pyxis, Enroot, Apptainer, or Singularity.
* Previous experience integrating Slurm with NVIDIA Base Command Manager, Bright Cluster Manager, or another cluster-management platform.
