description:
**Designation :Senior Network SME -Enterprise Infrastructure, Security and Cloud Networking**

**Experience: Minimum 13+ years**

**Certification: CCIE or CCNP**

**Role Type: Individual Contributor**

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Network Subject Matter Expert (SME) with a minimum of 13 years of hands-on experience in designing, supporting, securing and optimizing large-scale enterprise network environments. The role serves as a senior individual contributor and the highest level of technical escalation for complex network incidents, architectural decisions, technology standards and infrastructure transformation initiatives.

The successful candidate must hold a valid CCIE or CCNP certification and demonstrate expert-level capability across enterprise routing and switching, network security, WAN and SD-WAN, wireless, network access control, application delivery, cloud connectivity, monitoring and advanced troubleshooting.

**Role Purpose:**

• Provide authoritative technical leadership without direct people-management responsibility.

• Own complex troubleshooting, root cause analysis, design validation and technical risk assessment.

• Establish engineering standards, reference designs, operational runbooks and technical best practices.

• Ensure network solutions are resilient, secure, scalable, supportable and aligned with business requirements.

**Mandatory Qualifications**

**Experience:**

• Minimum 13 years of hands-on experience in enterprise networking, network security or infrastructure engineering.

• Proven experience supporting large and complex network estates, preferably exceeding 1,000 network devices across multiple sites or countries.

• Demonstrated experience as an L3 engineer, technical lead, network architect, principal engineer or subject matter expert.

• Strong background in major incident resolution, problem management, change implementation, capacity planning and network lifecycle management.

• Experience working in highly regulated environments such as financial services, banking or insurance is preferred.

**Certification:**

• CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure.

• CCNP Enterprise is mandatory where the candidate does not hold CCIE.

• Additional vendor certifications in Check Point, F5, Zscaler, Aruba, Cisco Wireless, Cisco ISE or Microsoft Azure are advantageous.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Act as the highest technical escalation point for critical and complex network incidents across routing, switching, security, wireless, WAN, SD-WAN and cloud connectivity.

• Lead deep technical investigations, packet-level analysis and root cause analysis, and define corrective and preventive actions.

• Review and validate high-level and low-level network designs, implementation plans, migration approaches, rollback plans and test strategies.

• Develop and maintain network architecture standards, configuration baselines, engineering guidelines, operational procedures and troubleshooting runbooks.

• Assess technical risks, infrastructure dependencies, performance constraints and security implications before production changes.

• Provide technical oversight during major upgrades, migrations, resilience tests, technology refreshes and infrastructure transformation programs.

• Identify recurring network issues and recommend automation, monitoring, capacity or design improvements.

• Conduct technical reviews with internal teams, service providers and technology vendors.

• Support governance, regulatory reviews and audits by providing accurate technical evidence and explanations.

• Mentor engineers through technical guidance, knowledge-sharing sessions and complex case reviews, without formal line-management responsibility.

**Core Technical Expertise**

**1. Enterprise Routing and Switching**

• Expert knowledge of BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, route redistribution, policy-based routing, PIM, multicast, GRE, VRF and first-hop redundancy protocols.

• Expert knowledge of VLANs, STP, RSTP, MST, EtherChannel, vPC, HSRP, QoS and high-availability designs.

• Advanced configuration and troubleshooting experience with Cisco Nexus 9000, 7000, 5000 and 2000 platforms, Cisco Catalyst switches, Cisco ASR and ISR routers.

• Experience with modern data-center technologies such as VXLAN EVPN is preferred.

**2. Network Security**

• Expert-level experience with Check Point firewalls, including security policy, NAT, VPN, IPS, threat prevention, application control, URL filtering and troubleshooting.

• Strong experience with Zscaler Internet Access or Blue Coat ProxySG, including SSL inspection, certificate validation, authentication integration and web-access troubleshooting.

• Working knowledge of security-zone design, segmentation, secure remote access and firewall-rule governance.

**3**
.
**Application Delivery and Load Balancing**

• Hands-on configuration and troubleshooting experience with F5 LTM, GTM and APM.

• Strong understanding of load-balancing methods, health monitors, SSL offloading, traffic management, application publishing and high availability.

**4.**
**Network Access Control and Identity**

• Strong experience with Forescout NAC and Cisco ISE, including 802.1X, MAB, RADIUS, TACACS+, endpoint profiling, posture, policy enforcement and dynamic VLAN assignment.

• Ability to troubleshoot authentication, authorization, profiling and endpoint-classification issues across wired and wireless environments.

**5.**
**Wireless Networking**

• Hands-on experience with Cisco and Aruba enterprise wireless solutions, including controllers, access points, WLAN configuration, RF optimization, roaming and high-density deployments.

• Ability to investigate wireless performance, interference, authentication, client-driver and connectivity issues using controller data, packet captures and endpoint logs.

**6.**
**WAN, VPN and SD-WAN**

• Strong knowledge of MPLS, Internet WAN, carrier circuits, site-to-site IPsec VPN, hybrid WAN and resilient active-active connectivity designs.

• Hands-on experience with Cisco SD-WAN or Citrix SD-WAN, including policy, path selection, traffic steering and troubleshooting.

**7. Cloud and Hybrid Networking**

• Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure networking, including VNETs, VNET peering, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Network Security Groups, Azure Firewall and load balancers.

• Understanding of hybrid-cloud connectivity, routing, segmentation, DNS integration and secure application access.

**8**
.
**Monitoring and Advanced Troubleshooting**

• Advanced troubleshooting using Wireshark and platform-specific debugs, logs and diagnostic commands.

• Experience with Splunk, network monitoring platforms, SNMP, syslog, NetFlow, alert correlation and performance trending.

• Ability to analyze latency, packet loss, retransmissions, routing instability, interface errors, hardware resource utilization and application-flow issues.

**Technical Deliverables**

• High-level and low-level network designs.

• Technical standards and configuration baselines.

• Root cause analysis and problem-management reports.

• Implementation, migration, rollback and validation plans.

• Resilience, failover and disaster-recovery test evidence.

• Risk assessments, capacity recommendations and lifecycle roadmaps.

• Operational procedures, troubleshooting guides and knowledge articles.

**Professional Competencies**

• Strong analytical and structured troubleshooting capability.

• Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to explain complex network issues in concise business terms.

• Sound judgement during high-severity incidents and production changes.

• Strong documentation, governance and audit-support discipline.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with operations, security, cloud, application and vendor teams.

**Preferred Industry and Environment**

• Financial services, banking, insurance or another regulated enterprise.

• Multi-country or regional infrastructure environment.

• Large managed-services or hybrid in-house/vendor delivery model.

• 24x7 business-critical infrastructure with formal incident, problem and change-management processes.

**Success Measures**

• Effective resolution of complex and high-severity network incidents.

• Reduction in repeat incidents through sustainable corrective actions.

• Quality and accuracy of network designs, standards and technical documentation.

• Successful delivery of migrations, upgrades and resilience testing with controlled risk.

• Improved network reliability, security, performance and operational supportability.

• Consistent knowledge transfer and technical uplift across engineering teams.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

A senior hands-on network specialist who combines CCIE or CCNP certification with 13+ years of enterprise experience, deep multi-domain expertise and the ability to own the most complex technical challenges from diagnosis through permanent resolution. This is an individual-contributor SME role, not an operations-management position.

title: EDI Engineer
description:
**Position Overview/Primary Purpose**

The EDI/MFT Senior Integration Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust integration solutions that support electronic data interchange (EDI) and managed file transfer (MFT) processes. This role ensures seamless, secure, and scalable data exchanges between internal systems and external partners. The position focuses on implementing best practices, troubleshooting complex issues, optimizing performance, and driving continuous improvement of enterprise integration platforms to meet evolving business and compliance needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and implement scalable EDI mappings and MFT solutions using Seeburger BIS and BIS Link, ensuring alignment with business and integration architecture standards.

* Configure partner profiles, trading relationships, and communication protocols (AS2, SFTP, HTTP, etc.), enabling secure and reliable B2B connectivity with trading partners.

* Develop, enhance, and maintain EDI mappings and transformations using Seeburger BICMD Mapping Designer, ensuring data accuracy and consistency across systems.

* Proactively monitor EDI/MFT processes, troubleshoot issues, and ensure high availability and performance of integration flows; provide L2/L3 support for incidents and error resolution.

* Lead and execute Seeburger implementation projects end-to-end, from requirement gathering through deployment, ensuring delivery within scope, timelines, and quality expectations.

* Work closely with internal teams, business users, and external partners to gather requirements, provide technical expertise, and ensure successful integration outcomes.

* Ensure adherence to industry standards, data security, and compliance requirements; manage and perform production deployments of mappings and workflows as needed.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

* Drive continuous improvement and optimization of EDI/MFT processes and performance

* Document integration designs, mappings, and operational procedures

* Document integration designs, mappings, and operational procedures

* Support audit and compliance activities related to data exchange processes

* Participate in on-call support and incident management if required

**Required Qualifications:**

**Level of Education and Discipline**

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Certifications and/or Licenses**

Certification in Seeburger BIS or related Seeburger technologies

**Experience**

* 8–10+ years of experience in EDI, B2B integration, and Managed File Transfer domains
* 6+ years of hands-on experience with Seeburger BIS platform
* Strong, hands-on experience with:
* Seeburger Business Integration Suite (BIS 7 and above)
* Seeburger BICMD Mapping Designer
* BIS Manager and BIS Link
* EDI and MFT implementations
* Proven experience designing and supporting enterprise-scale B2B integration landscapes, including partner onboarding and multi-protocol communication
* Strong understanding of EDI standards and formats: EDIFACT, ANSI X12, EANCOM, Tradacoms, UCS, VIC.S
* Expertise in communication protocols such as AS2, SFTP, FTP/S, HTTP/S
* Proficiency in data mapping, transformation, routing, and error handling
* Experience integrating Seeburger with SAP (IDoc, RFC, Proxy, APIs) and understanding of SAP ABAP concepts
* Solid understanding of integration patterns, message lifecycle, and security frameworks (encryption, signing, certificates)
* Strong functional and business knowledge to translate requirements into effective integration solutions

title: Cloud Service Operations Engineer (*Windchill Support)
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
  
  
Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Associate Engineer – Windchill Cloud is responsible for supporting the deployment, configuration, maintenance, and upgrade of PTC Windchill applications hosted in cloud environments. Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the role focuses on delivering reliable cloud services, resolving technical issues, and ensuring compliance with PTC Cloud standards, security practices, and operational procedures.

**Upgrades & Support**

* Assist in executing Windchill version upgrades, CPS, and MR updates.
* Perform post-upgrade validation and basic troubleshooting.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

title: Specialist, IT Infrastructure (Database)
description:
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
  
  
**Specialist, IT Infrastructure (Database)**
Job ID: 36969
  
  
Job Level: S2 Core
  
  
Job Location: Gurugram / Bangalore
  
  
Function:Digital Information Office (DIO)
  
  
Employment Type: Full time
  
  
Working pattern: Hybrid
  
  
**Why we need this role**
We are seeking a Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer with deep technical expertise in Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server platforms. This role is a hands-on Subject Matter Expert (SME) responsible for designing, optimising, securing, and supporting business-critical database services across on-premises and hybrid cloud environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring resilient, secure, compliant, and cost-efficient database solutions are designed and delivered. They will contribute to technology roadmaps, driving automation, and supporting strategic initiatives such as upgrades, migrations, consolidation, high availability, disaster recovery, and cloud modernisation.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Act as a technical SME for Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server platforms.
* Design, implement, and support database solutions for business-critical workloads across Production, Development, Test, and Disaster Recovery environments.
* Own and provide technical direction for Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard, GoldenGate, RMAN, and Enterprise Manager solutions.
* Own and provide technical direction for SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, replication, log shipping, backup, recovery, and monitoring solutions.
* Deliver against database platform strategy and roadmap, including upgrades, migrations, consolidation, modernisation, and remediation of end-of-life or end-of-support platforms.
* Drive platform stability, performance, capacity, availability, and resilience, ensuring database services meet operational and business requirements.
* Lead complex performance tuning, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution of major incidents and recurring problems.
* Develop and maintain robust backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities, including regular validation and failover testing.
* Identify and deliver cost optimisation opportunities across database licensing, infrastructure utilisation, consolidation, storage, and support models.
* Develop automation and standardisation using Ansible, PowerShell, Shell scripting, Python, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
* Ensure database security through patching, vulnerability remediation, privileged access controls, hardening, encryption, auditing, and compliance evidence.
* Collaborate closely with application owners, operating system teams, cloud engineering teams, architecture, security, network, storage, vendors, and wider Infrastructure & Operations teams.
* Maintain high-quality technical documentation, including platform designs, standards, build guides, runbooks, operational procedures, capacity reports, and audit artefacts.
* Provide technical leadership for major changes and projects, including planning, risk assessment, implementation, validation, and rollback.
* Participate in the on-call rota to support critical incidents.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong hands-on experience administering enterprise-scale Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server environments.
* Deep Oracle expertise covering RAC, ASM, Data Guard, GoldenGate, RMAN, performance tuning, patching, upgrades, and migrations.
* Deep SQL Server expertise covering Always On Availability Groups, clustering, replication, log shipping, backup and recovery, performance tuning, patching, upgrades, and migrations.
* Proven experience supporting highly available, business-critical production database services.
* Experience leading database upgrades, migrations, consolidations, platform refreshes, and disaster recovery implementations.
* Strong knowledge of database monitoring, capacity management, alerting, incident management, and proactive problem prevention.
* Experience working in hybrid environments, integrating on-premises database platforms with Azure, OCI, AWS, or GCP services.
* Solid knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems, compute, storage, networking, clustering, and virtualisation fundamentals.
* Strong troubleshooting capability across complex, multi-layered database and infrastructure environments.
* Experience with automation tools such as Ansible and scripting technologies such as PowerShell, Shell, or Python.
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes, change governance, audit controls, security compliance, and vulnerability remediation.

**Technical Competencies**

* Deep technical expertise and recognition as a go-to SME for Oracle and SQL Server platforms.
* Ability to independently lead technical delivery of complex database changes, migrations, upgrades, and recovery activities.
* Strong understanding of high availability, resiliency, backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery design.
* Advanced database performance analysis, optimisation, capacity planning, and root cause analysis skills.
* Experience with automation, standardisation, optimisation, and platform engineering practices.
* Ability to define database standards, reference architectures, operational controls, and lifecycle roadmaps.
* Ability to contribute to design and technology decisions in partnership with architecture, security, cloud, and application teams.

**Behavioural & Professional Skills**

* Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for database platform stability, security, and technical outcomes.
* Technical Leadership: Influences engineering direction and mentors colleagues without requiring direct line management responsibility.
* Outcome-Driven: Focuses on measurable improvements in availability, performance, cost, security, and resilience.
* Collaboration: Works effectively across infrastructure, cloud, security, architecture, application, and supplier teams.
* Communication: Clearly articulates complex database concepts, risks, options, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies opportunities for automation, optimisation, simplification, and service improvement.

**What We Offer You**
**Looking to make a mark?**
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
  
  
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
  
  
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
  
  
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
  
  
**Diversity and inclusion**

* Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.

**Most Recently We Have**

* Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
* Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
* Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.

**Benefits**
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
  
  

* Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
* Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
* Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
* Global Family Leave Policy.
* Employee Assistance Program.
* Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.

**A global network**

* When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

title: Design & Planning Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Design & Planning Specialist designs, analyses, plans, and modifies network components supporting customer communication implementation activities. Develops and evaluates network performance criteria and measurement methods. Prepares the analysis of the short or long-term capacity needs for switching, routing transmission, and signalling. Conducts network architecture design, feasibility, and cost studies. Develops alternative routing scenarios and changes in required sequence of network activities. Conducts economic and population growth studies to determine impact on network capacity and development plan projections. Performs the end-to-end design activities (including surveys, design itself, and as-built) required for a physical network deployment.

* Develop and execute Acceptance Test Plans (ATPs), support customer acceptance activities, and perform vertical and horizontal integration.
* Troubleshoot technical issues, support First Office Application (FOA) activities, provide timely resolutions, and ensure successful production deployments.
* Build trusted technical advisory relationships with customer engineering stakeholders while working autonomously and applying best practices to improve products, services, and delivery outcomes.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master's preferred).
* 4+ years of telecom experience with Core Network deployment, integration, and validation (mandatory).
* Strong knowledge of Cloud Native technologies, DevOps, CI/CD, and hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm (mandatory).
* Experience with Linux, basic shell scripting, TCP/IP networking, TLS certificates, Kubernetes firewall configuration, and editing YAML/JSON configuration files.
* Good understanding of telecom protocols and interfaces, including IPv4/IPv6, HTTP/HTTPS, REST, SOAP, LDAP, SPML, Diameter, XML, and YAML/JSON.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, including Wireshark log analysis, IP connectivity debugging, and network issue resolution.
* Experience executing functional, regression, sanity, load, and performance testing, including simulator/emulator setup and environment configuration.

description:

The individual will oversee day-to-day operations, lead strategic initiatives, drive continuous improvement, partner with business and technology stakeholders, and ensure a seamless end-user technology experience across all India locations. title: Consulting Architect - Platform
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.
  
  
That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments
* Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form
* Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds
* Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures
* Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path
* Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end
* Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting
* Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice

**What You Bring:**
**Elastic depth — non-negotiable**
We
**are not looking**
for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.
  
  

* 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring
* Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time
* Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance
* Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each
* Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured
* Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position
* More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option
* Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries
* Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter
* Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking
* A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do
* Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

**The Role**
We are looking for a technical support engineer to join our team in Gurgaon (hybrid) and help keep our production systems healthy through the night. This is a night-shift role, primarily graveyard hours (10:00 PM – 7:00 AM IST), rotating between two team members. You will be the first line of response for production alerts, incident triage and customer-facing technical issues outside regular business hours, making sure AiDASH products and platforms keep delivering for our customers around the clock.
  
  
How you'll make an impact:

title: Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Designation: Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer- Infrastructure, Cloud & Endpoint Operations

Location: Gurgaon or Hyderabad

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for designing, building, configuring, and maintaining Xebia's server, virtualisation, cloud, and end-user computing infrastructure. The role owns the health, security, performance, and cost-efficiency of the infrastructure estate — from on-premises and virtual servers through to Microsoft 365 and multi-cloud environments — and ensures everything is configured, governed, and documented to enterprise standards.

The role combines deep technical expertise in server and policy configuration, virtualisation, and cloud administration with strong governance discipline across Microsoft 365, software asset management, cloud spend, and supplier relationships. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable creating and hardening virtual machines, authoring group and security policies, optimising cloud cost, and managing vendors — while automating repetitive work wherever possible.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Server Administration & Policy Configuration**

• Build, configure, harden, patch, and maintain Windows and Linux servers across physical, virtual, and cloud environments to enterprise security baselines.

• Design and manage Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), security policies, and configuration baselines; enforce least-privilege and standardised builds.

• Configure server roles and services — DNS, DHCP, file/print, IIS, certificate services, and clustering / high availability.

• Maintain gold images, build standards, and configuration management to ensure consistency across the estate.

**2. Virtualisation & VM Lifecycle Management**

• Expertly create, configure, size, and manage virtual machines across VMware vSphere / ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

• Define and apply VM policies — resource allocation, affinity/anti-affinity rules, snapshots, templates, tagging, naming conventions, and lifecycle governance.

• Manage virtualisation hosts, clusters, storage (SAN/NAS), and capacity planning; optimise performance and utilisation.

**3. Microsoft 365 Governance & Rule Management**

• Administer and govern the Microsoft 365 tenant — Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Intune — to enterprise standards.

• Configure and manage mail flow / transport rules, retention and DLP policies, compliance and sensitivity labels, and eDiscovery.

• Govern identity and access via Microsoft Entra ID — conditional access, MFA, licensing assignment, and endpoint/device management through Intune.

• Define and enforce M365 governance for provisioning, external sharing, guest access, and lifecycle management of Teams / groups / sites.

**4. Cloud Engineering & Infrastructure Management**

• Act as a cloud engineer for the estate — architect, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure across Azure (primary), AWS, and/or GCP — compute, storage, networking, and identity.

• Design and manage cloud networking — virtual networks, subnets, load balancers, VPN / ExpressRoute, DNS, and firewall / NSG rules.

• Define landing zones, resource governance, tagging, RBAC, and Azure Policy / guardrails for secure and consistent provisioning.

• Build and manage CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, ARM/Bicep) pipelines to automate provisioning and enforce consistency.

• Engineer scalability, resilience, and high availability — auto-scaling, redundancy, and multi-region / availability-zone design.

**5. Cloud Cost, FinOps & Spend Management**

• Own cloud spend management — monitor consumption, forecast, and report on cloud cost against budget across all subscriptions/accounts.

• Drive FinOps practices — rightsizing, reserved instances / savings plans, auto-scaling, and elimination of idle or orphaned resources.

• Produce cost dashboards and chargeback / showback reporting; identify and deliver measurable cost-optimisation opportunities.

**6. Software Asset Management (SAM) & Licensing**

• Own the Software Asset Management lifecycle — discovery, inventory, entitlement reconciliation, and effective-licence-position (ELP) reporting.

• Manage licensing across Microsoft, VMware, and other key vendors; ensure compliance and audit-readiness and avoid over- or under-licensing.

• Maintain the CMDB / asset register for hardware and software; manage renewals, true-ups, and lifecycle retirement.

**7. Identity & Access Management (IAM) Architecture**

• Act as the IAM architect for the estate — design and maintain the identity architecture across Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and federated / SaaS identity providers.

• Architect authentication and authorisation patterns — SSO, MFA, conditional access, SCIM provisioning, and least-privilege / RBAC and ABAC models.

• Design and manage privileged access management (PAM), Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and just-in-time / zero-standing-privilege access.

• Automate the full identity lifecycle — joiner-mover-leaver, access reviews, entitlement management, and periodic recertification.

• Manage endpoint provisioning, imaging, patching, and compliance through Intune / Autopilot / SCCM (MECM); enforce endpoint security baselines, encryption, and configuration policies.

**8. Backup, Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity**

• Design, implement, and test backup and disaster-recovery solutions with defined RPO/RTO targets.

• Manage backup tooling (e.g. Veeam, Azure Backup), replication, and periodic recovery testing.

• Maintain and regularly rehearse business-continuity and DR runbooks.

**9. Monitoring, Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code**

• Implement proactive monitoring, alerting, and observability across servers, cloud, and endpoints (e.g. Azure Monitor, Nagios, Zabbix, PRTG).

• Automate routine operations using PowerShell, Python, Bash, and CI/CD pipelines to reduce manual effort and configuration drift.

• Maintain accurate documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles.

**10. Vendor, Supplier & Service Management**

• Manage infrastructure suppliers and cloud partners — performance against SLAs, contract and renewal management, and escalations.

• Evaluate new tools and services; build business cases and coordinate procurement with IT leadership.

• Operate within ITIL-aligned change, incident, and problem management processes.

**EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS**

**Education**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

**Required / Preferred Certifications**

• Microsoft: AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), MS-102 (M365 Administrator), AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect) or MCSE.

• Virtualisation: VMware VCP-DCV; Microsoft Hyper-V experience.

• Cloud (additional): AWS SysOps Administrator / Solutions Architect, or equivalent GCP certification.

• Service & asset management: ITIL Foundation; FinOps Certified Practitioner; IAITAM CSAM / CHAMP (SAM).

• Identity & Access Management: SC-300 (Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator); Entra ID / Active Directory administration.

• Security-adjacent (advantageous): AZ-500 (Azure Security), CompTIA Server+ / Security+.

**EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

• Minimum 8–10 years of hands-on IT infrastructure experience across servers, virtualisation, and cloud in an enterprise environment.

• Proven expertise configuring server and group/security policies, and creating and governing virtual machines at scale.

• Demonstrable experience with Microsoft 365 governance, transport/DLP rule management, and Entra ID administration.

• Strong track record managing cloud spend / FinOps and Software Asset Management (SAM) and licensing compliance.

• Experience managing suppliers and cloud partners within ITIL-aligned operations.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

**Core Technical Skills**

• Windows Server & Linux administration; Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI/certificates.

• Virtualisation: VMware vSphere/ESXi, Hyper-V; VM creation, policies, templates, and lifecycle.

• Microsoft 365 & Entra ID: Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune, conditional access, transport/DLP/retention rules.

• Identity & Access Management (IAM) architecture: Entra ID / Active Directory design, SSO, MFA, conditional access, SCIM, RBAC/ABAC, PAM / PIM, and identity lifecycle automation.

• Cloud engineering: architecting and operating Azure (primary), AWS/GCP — compute, storage, cloud networking, RBAC, Azure Policy, landing zones, and high-availability design.

• FinOps & cost management; Software Asset Management (SAM) and licensing (Microsoft, VMware).

• Automation & IaC: PowerShell, Python, Bash, Terraform, ARM/Bicep.

• Backup/DR (Veeam, Azure Backup); monitoring & observability tooling.

**SOFT SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:**

• Problem-solving: Strong analytical and structured problem-solving with a methodical, documentation-driven approach.

• Communication: Clear written and verbal English; able to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.

• Ownership: Reliable ownership of infrastructure health, security, and cost with minimal supervision.

• Automation mindset: A default preference for automating repetitive work and eliminating configuration drift.

• Collaboration: Effective supplier and cross-team collaboration within ITIL processes.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

• Based in Gurgaon or Hyderabad, with flexibility to work in shifts and provide on-call / out-of-hours support as required.

• Willingness to travel occasionally to other Xebia sites for infrastructure projects.

• High integrity and commitment to maintaining the confidentiality of all client, applicant, and company information.

title: Senior Solution Implementation Specialist
description:
Software Implementation (SWI) Engineer
**Location:**
India
**Team:**
Software Implementation (SWI)
**Travel:**
Willingness and ability to travel internationally, including to the United States
**Experience:**
3–8 years preferred About the SWI Team The
**Software Implementation (SWI) team**
is responsible for ensuring the successful implementation, integration, testing, and deployment of GreyOrange software and automation solutions at customer sites. SWI engineers work at the intersection of
**software, testing, automation, and customer implementation**
. The role involves working closely with GreyOrange products, simulations and emulations, customer systems, and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure solutions are thoroughly validated and successfully transitioned into production. This is a highly technical, hands-on role for engineers who enjoy
**troubleshooting complex software issues, testing APIs and integrations, writing automation scripts, and working directly with customers**
. Key Responsibilities Software Testing & Validation
  
  

* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing of GreyOrange products and solutions.
* Execute simulation and emulation testing to validate system behavior before and during customer implementations.
* Develop and execute detailed test scenarios, test cases, and validation plans.
* Identify, reproduce, troubleshoot, and document software defects and integration issues.
* Perform log analysis and root-cause investigation of complex technical issues.
* Validate system performance, reliability, and interoperability across multiple software and hardware components.

Customer Implementation & Deployment
  
  

* Work directly with customers throughout the implementation lifecycle, including:

+ SIT (System Integration Testing)
+ UAT (User Acceptance Testing)
+ HAT (Hardware Acceptance Testing)
+ Go-Live
+ Post-Go-Live Support

* Collaborate with customer IT, engineering, and operations teams to troubleshoot and resolve implementation issues.
* Support software configuration, integration validation, deployment readiness, and production cutover activities.
* Participate in on-site customer deployments and provide hands-on technical support during critical implementation phases.
* Communicate technical issues, risks, status, and resolutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technical Troubleshooting & Automation
  
  

* Use Python, Unix/Linux, SQL, JSON, REST APIs, and Postman extensively for testing, troubleshooting, and automation.
* Write and maintain shell scripts to automate testing, diagnostics, deployments, and repetitive operational tasks.
* Analyze application and system logs to identify problems and isolate root causes.
* Debug API, database, integration, configuration, and environment-related issues.
* Develop utilities and scripts that improve testing efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Validate data flows between GreyOrange products and customer systems.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong software testing and debugging fundamentals.
* Python – scripting, automation, debugging, and test utilities.
* Unix/Linux – strong command-line skills, troubleshooting, process management, logs, permissions, networking basics, etc.
* Shell scripting – ability to write, understand, and debug Bash/shell scripts.
* SQL – ability to query databases, validate data, troubleshoot data issues, and perform complex queries.
* JSON – strong understanding of JSON structures and data manipulation.
* REST APIs – strong understanding of API-based integrations and troubleshooting.
* Postman – ability to create, execute, and troubleshoot API collections and test scenarios.
* Strong understanding of software integration and distributed-system concepts.
* Experience with log analysis and systematic root-cause analysis.
* Familiarity with source control systems such as Git.
* Ability to quickly understand new products, architectures, APIs, and technical environments.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with warehouse automation, robotics, logistics, fulfillment, or enterprise software implementations.
* Experience testing complex distributed systems or highly integrated software platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD and automated testing frameworks.
* Familiarity with messaging systems, databases, networking, and cloud environments.
* Experience working with customer-facing implementation or professional services teams.
* Experience supporting production systems and critical go-live events.
* Knowledge of test automation frameworks such as PyTest or similar tools.
* Exposure to Docker/Kubernetes or other modern deployment technologies is a plus.

What We're Looking For We are looking for
**strong hands-on engineers—not just manual testers**
. The ideal candidate:
  
  

* Is technically curious and enjoys solving difficult problems.
* Can independently investigate an issue from a customer symptom down to the underlying technical root cause.
* Is comfortable working from the Linux command line and writing scripts to diagnose problems.
* Can use Python, SQL, APIs, Postman, and shell scripting as everyday engineering tools.
* Has strong analytical and debugging skills.
* Can work effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving implementation environments.
* Is comfortable interacting directly with customers and explaining technical issues clearly.
* Takes ownership of problems through resolution rather than simply reporting defects.
* Can work collaboratively with Software Engineering, QA, Product, Solutions, and Customer teams.
* Is willing to travel internationally, including extended on-site assignments in the United States, based on project requirements.

Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.
* 3–8 years of relevant experience in software testing, QA automation, system integration, implementation, production support, or a related engineering role.
* Candidates with exceptional technical skills and relevant hands-on experience are encouraged to apply regardless of exact years of experience.

Why Join the SWI Team? The SWI team offers an opportunity to work on
**real-world, mission-critical automation implementations**
and see software solutions move from development and simulation all the way through customer acceptance and production. You will work across
**engineering, testing, automation, integration, and customer deployment**
, gaining exposure to complex systems while playing a direct role in delivering successful customer outcomes.
**If you are an engineer who loves debugging, automation, APIs, Linux, and solving problems in the real world—and you're excited to work directly with customers and travel internationally—we'd like to hear from you.**

**:**

The GDS Cyber Architecture Operational Technology & Engineering (CAOE) services help our clients tackle the many security challenges they face on a daily basis and develop effective solutions using people, processes and technology, while enabling better security and risk decisions, and reducing costs related to manging security risks. The CAOE team is looking for individuals who will play a direct role in delivery of Operational Technology (OT) security engagements, development of proposals in this area, and develop OT security solutions. You will play a key role in supporting our clients to secure their IT/OT environments, either through advisory and/or implementation support.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor OT networks using specialized OT SOC and network monitoring tools
* Analyse alerts from OT security monitoring solutions (e.g., Nozomi, Claroty, Tenable.ot, Defender for IoT, etc.)
* Identify suspicious activities, anomalies, and indicators of compromise (IoCs) affecting ICS environments
* Perform Level 2 alert triage and investigation for OT incidents
* Support for OT cybersecurity incident response activities
* Understanding of security-related operational processes in the OT-ICS environments
* Understanding of technologies (typical assets, communication protocols, technical architectures) utilized by OT-ICS systems and networks
* Knowledge of cyber / information security concepts, risk and controls concepts
* Understanding of aspects of functional safety (SIS)
* Knowledge of TCP/IP, concepts of OSI layer and protocols, networking and security concepts
* Knowledge of the technical security solutions utilized within OT-ICS systems and networks
* Knowledge of OS (Windows / Linux) security, Database security
* Prior experience working alongside delivery leads and architects to Identify and manage risks is a plus

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Knowledge of OT-ICS Security standards, including ISA/IEC 62443, NIST 800-82, NERC-CIP
* Understanding of IT/OT/IoT communication protocols e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 61850, OPC, OPC UA, PROFINET, BLE, Zigbee
* Knowledge of standards such as ISO 27001/2, ISO 22301, ISO 27018, NIST standards on Cyber Security, HITRUST, etc. is a plus

* 5+ years of experience in the Cyber Security and OT Security Domain

* ISA/IEC 62443 Fundamentals Specialist

description:

title: Microsoft 365 Consultant
description:
**About the Company:**

A leading Microsoft Solutions Partner helping mid-market organisations strengthen their digital infrastructure and adopt modern Microsoft technologies. The company provides expertise across Microsoft 365, Azure, Data & AI, Security, Copilot, and Digital & Application Innovation.

With over a decade of experience, 125+ clients, 200+ projects, and a strong client retention record, the organisation works with businesses across financial services, travel and logistics, manufacturing, consulting, and BPO/offshore services in India and the UK.

**Role overview:**

We are a Microsoft partner and managed services provider looking for a skilled M365 Engineer to join our delivery team. This is a hands-on technical role with a strong ownership mindset. You will manage M365 environments for multiple clients, lead migrations, mentor junior engineers, and be the go-to technical authority for everything in the Microsoft 365 stack.

This role is not internal IT support. You will work directly with clients, own technical outcomes, and operate with high autonomy.

**What you will do:**

* Own end-to-end M365 migrations — on-prem Exchange to Exchange Online, tenant-to-tenant, hybrid coexistence setup and cutover
* Administer Exchange Online, Exchange hybrid environments, mail flow, connectors, and messaging security (SPF/DKIM/DMARC)
* Design and implement Conditional Access policies, MFA, and identity governance using Entra ID
* Manage SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and M365 security and compliance (Purview, DLP, eDiscovery, retention)
* Serve as technical escalation point for junior engineers on M365 issues
* Lead client-facing calls, gather requirements, and translate them into technical solutions
* Build and maintain SOPs, runbooks, and technical documentation for managed clients
* Proactively monitor client environments, identify risks, and drive resolution before incidents occur
* Support license management, tenant health, and periodic reporting for managed accounts

**Must have:**

* 5–7 years of hands-on M365 administration experience
* Proven experience executing
  **M365 migrations**
  — on-prem Exchange to M365, cutover, staged, or tenant-to-tenant (not just supporting, must have led or owned a migration)
* Exchange hybrid administration — connectors, coexistence, attribute sync, free/busy, hybrid mail flow troubleshooting
* Exchange Online depth — EAC, PowerShell, transport rules, retention/MRM, compliance, anti-spam, message trace
* Strong PowerShell scripting for M365 administration and reporting
* Experience working in an MSP, consulting firm, or multi-client environment

**Good to have:**

* Entra ID (Azure AD) — Conditional Access, MFA, Entra Connect, hybrid identity, SSPR
* Microsoft Intune — device compliance policies, app deployment, MDM/MAM
* Microsoft Purview — eDiscovery, DLP, insider risk, sensitivity labels
* Microsoft Exchange On-prem experience
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert

**What we are not looking for:**

* Candidates from large enterprise internal IT with no multi-client or consulting exposure
* Profiles with Exchange Online breadth but no hybrid or migration experience
* Anyone who has not personally owned or led an M365 migration end-to-end

**What good looks like beyond the tech:**

* Communicates technical issues clearly to non-technical clients — calm under pressure
* Proactive — identifies problems before clients do and comes with solutions
* Comfortable mentoring junior engineers and reviewing their work
* Structured and documentation-oriented
* Pushes back professionally when a client decision creates risk.

**Work Location:**
Noida (WFO)

title: Deputy Manager - Cyber Security
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Adani Group:**
In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Business Unit Cyber Specialist will be responsible for providing specialized cybersecurity expertise and support within a specific business unit. This role focuses on identifying, assessing, and mitigating cybersecurity risks while ensuring that security practices align with business objectives. The Cyber Specialist will act as the main point of contact for all cybersecurity-related issues within the business unit, ensuring that all security requirements are met and that the business unit operates within a secure, compliant, and risk-managed environment.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**BU Cyber Specialist**
**Cybersecurity Risk Identification And Mitigation**
Identify cybersecurity risks within the business unit’s operations, including systems, processes, and workflows.
  
  
Work with cross-functional teams to implement appropriate security measures and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
Provide guidance on threat mitigation strategies and assist with implementing security measures to address identified vulnerabilities.
  
  
**Security Incident Response**
Act as a key contributor to the business unit’s cybersecurity incident response plan.
  
  
Assist in investigating and analyzing security incidents, ensuring timely detection, containment, and resolution of security breaches.
  
  
Work closely with the incident response team to execute response strategies and remediate vulnerabilities.
  
  
**Collaboration With IT And Business Teams**
Partner with IT teams to ensure secure implementation and maintenance of business unit systems and applications.
  
  
Collaborate with business unit leaders to integrate cybersecurity best practices into daily operations, projects, and system development.
  
  
Provide security guidance and support to business units when implementing new technologies, applications, or processes.
  
  
**Compliance And Regulatory Support**
Ensure the business unit complies with relevant cybersecurity regulations, standards, and internal policies (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, NIST).
  
  
Assist with audits and assessments to verify compliance with industry-specific cybersecurity requirements.
  
  
Provide recommendations for improving security posture to ensure compliance with relevant regulations.
  
  
**Security Awareness And Training**
Assist in the development and delivery of cybersecurity awareness and training programs tailored to the business unit’s needs.
  
  
Provide guidance to business unit staff on security best practices, including data protection, password management, and secure communication.
  
  
Promote a security-conscious culture within the business unit by conducting ongoing awareness activities and security drills.
  
  
**Security Tools And Technologies**
Support the implementation, configuration, and management of cybersecurity tools and technologies within the business unit.
  
  
Assist with monitoring and maintaining the security of business unit systems, including vulnerability scanning, network monitoring, and endpoint protection.
  
  
Provide recommendations on security tools and technologies that align with the business unit’s needs and the organization's overall cybersecurity strategy.
  
  
**Reporting And Communication**
Report on cybersecurity risks, incidents, and initiatives to the Business Unit Cyber Lead and other relevant stakeholders.
  
  
Maintain documentation of security activities, incidents, and ongoing efforts to improve cybersecurity posture.
  
  
Communicate security risks and recommended actions to business unit leadership in a clear and concise manner.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement And Best Practices**
Stay up to date with the latest cybersecurity trends, threats, and technologies to ensure that the business unit remains secure against emerging risks.
  
  
Continuously evaluate and improve cybersecurity practices and procedures within the business unit to adapt to the evolving threat landscape.
  
  
Assist in the development and implementation of security best practices for the business unit.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Business Unit Heads and Department Heads
  
  
Business Unit Cyber Lead
  
  
Information Security and IT teams
  
  
Legal, HR, and Compliance teams
  
  
Risk Management Teams
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Regulatory Authorities and Compliance Organizations
  
  
Security Vendors and Third-Party Service Providers
  
  
External Auditors
  
  
**Educational Qualification**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  
  
Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.
  
  
**Certification**
Industry certifications such as CISSP, CompTIA Security+, or CISM are preferred.
  
  
Solid understanding of cybersecurity risks, policies, and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR).
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
3+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on risk management, security operations, or system security.

title: Cyber Security Architect
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Security Consultant/Architect with a deep understanding of telecom network security to join our team. You will be responsible for providing expert security guidance, designing secure network solutions, and implementing best practices for our complex and dynamic telecom network infrastructure. This role requires a strong understanding of security principles, methodologies, and best practices specifically tailored to the telecom industry, as well as the ability to work independently and collaboratively with various stakeholders.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Provide expert security consulting services: Advise clients on best practices for securing their telecom networks, including threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Design and architect secure network solutions: Develop and implement secure network architectures, including firewall configurations, intrusion detection systems, VPNs, and network segmentation, tailored to the specific needs of telecom clients.
* Conduct security assessments and audits: Identify vulnerabilities and security weaknesses in existing telecom networks and recommend remediation strategies.
* Develop and implement security policies and procedures: Work with clients to establish comprehensive security policies and procedures that align with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Stay abreast of emerging security threats and vulnerabilities: Focus on threats and vulnerabilities specific to the telecom industry and recommend appropriate countermeasures for the network.
* Participate in incident response activities: Provide technical expertise and guidance related to security incidents affecting the telecom network.
* Develop and deliver security awareness training programs: Tailor training programs to the specific needs of personnel involved in managing and operating the telecom network.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of the organization's overall security strategy: Focus on the security strategy for the telecom network and its integration with the broader organizational security strategy.
* Often leads longer-term MSS complex improvement projects with moderate resource requirements, risk and complexity.

**Key Skills And Experience**
Must-have skill:
  
  

* Telecom Security Architecture – 7–10 years of experience in cybersecurity, network security architecture, or security consulting within the telecom industry, with strong knowledge of telecom security principles and best practices.

title: Customer Solutions Design Practitioner
description:
Job Title: Customer Solutions Design Practitioner
  
  
Req ID: 61586
  
  
Job Function: Service
  
  
Posting Start Date: 06/10/2026
  
  
Posting End Date: 08/10/2026
  
  
Division: Business
  
  
Job Location: IND Gurugram Tower C&D
  
  
Advertised Salary: Within Range
  
  
**Role Summary**
**What I’ll be doing – your accountabilities**
Own lifecycle operations for 4G/5G Enterprise Packet Core nodes. Also specialize in Nokia SR OS-based IP/MPLS networks and NFM-P operations: including audits, remediation, vendor coordination, and risk-controlled upgrades. Ensure stability, security, and performance through automation, observability, and disciplined change control.
  
  

* Provides technical concurrence and sign off for high profile and/or critical network changes on major BT core platforms and/or customer bids; accountable for managing technical risk for major platforms.
* Provides consultancy on network designs for multiple platforms and/or solutions and/or customers
* Develops design patterns across multiple domains.
* Responsible for establishing design best practice within a unit.
* Responsible for estimating the time and type of resource needed to support deliverables for complex, high impact and high value projects.
* Drives Right First-Time solutions and leads lessons learned
* Proposes technical strategy to network platforms and/or customer solutions factoring in high impact and high risk as appropriate.
* Drives efficiency and scalability through the re-use of network designs and accountable for the design whilst it is deployed across the overall network platform and/or customer solution.
* Potentially leads a large matrix team (virtual) and is accountable for complex network development using innovative approaches to design (including cross-portfolio solutions). Leverages technical resource/s as required to deliver the solution.
* Decides on design scope and design to leading edge high impact and high-risk network platforms and/or customer solutions
* Audit & Install Base: inventory Packet Core Nodes, licenses, versions, dependencies
* Remediation: resolve routing/subscriber database/QoS issues, security baselines; troubleshoot EPC/5GC signaling/session problems and database replication
* Lifecycle Upgrades: plan/execute software upgrades (schema migrations, config freezes, interop testing) from lab → pilot → production
* Audit & Install Base: inventory Nokia SR OS devices (7750/7705), releases, line cards, license keys, HA, and NFM-P components
* Service Audit: document L2/L3 VPNs, VPLS/EVPN, QoS policies, OAM, BFD, telemetry/alarms; validate compliance
* Remediation: resolve routing instabilities, LDP/RSVP/SR issues, QoS defects, MTU mismatches; fix HA/ISSU configurations
* Lifecycle Upgrades: plan/perform Nokia SR OS and NFM-P upgrades/patches, using ISSU/hitless strategies where supported; manage pre/post checks and rollback
* Scripting & Automation: automate audits/compliance and mass changes via MD-CLI scripting, NETCONF/gNMI, Python/Ansible; integrate with NFM-P APIs
* Risk Management: craft traffic reroute plans, staged upgrades, failover testing, and thorough rollback procedures
* Vendor Engagement: work with Cisco, NetNumber and Nokia teams on constraints, field notices and recommended upgrade paths; complete impact assessments
* Scripting & Automation: build Ansible/Python playbooks for config validation, backups, compliance, health checks, and API-based changes (NETCONF/RESTCONF)
* Risk Management: define change windows, traffic steering/bypass, rollback/fallback routing; maintain risk registers and detailed MOPs
* Security & Compliance: lifecycle, segmentation, logging; track vulnerabilities and apply timely remediations
* Observability: maintain dashboards/alerts (latency, loss, success rates) and baseline KPIs for core interfaces
* Documentation & Recommendations: deliver execution plans, risk assessments, impact analyses, and optimization recommendations
* Decides on network models for design testing.
* Decides on approach to resolving customer affected issues to leading edge high impact and high-risk network platforms and/or customer solutions, as appropriate.
* Resolves in-life issues to high risk and high impact network platforms and/or customer solutions, as appropriate
* Decides how to re-use network designs.
* Decides on implementation approaches of technology related transformation activity.

**Skills Required For The Job**
Provide detailed information on any qualifications, technical expertise or security clearance that you will need for the job. (See example statements below).
  
  

* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Mobile Network domain
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in IP Routing and IP/MPLS domain
* Strong understanding of 4G and 5G packet core domain
* Minimum 5-8 years of hand on experience in Nokia 4G/5G CMU (Compact Mobility Unit) product.
* Minimum 5-8 years of hand on experience in Cisco 4G/5G Packet Core product.
* Minimum 5-8 years of hand on experience in NetNumber HSS.
* 5–8+ years operating Nokia SR OS IP/MPLS networks and NFM-P Minimum.
* Hands-on NFM-P administration, backups, device onboarding, job scheduling
* Scripting (Python, Ansible) and model-driven ops (NETCONF/YANG, gNMI)
* Strong change management and risk/rollback practices
* Good to have working experience on enterprise and mobile private networks
* Key achievements in technical expertise on his/her domain.

**Common Deliverables:**

* Install Base Report: HW/SW versions, licenses and dependencies
* Remediation Plan: defects found, risk, timeline, and expected outcomes
* Lifecycle Upgrade Execution Plan (MOP): steps, validations, rollback, comms
* Risk Register: risks, impact assessment, mitigations
* Post-Change Report: KPI deltas, incident summary, lessons learned
* Automation Assets: scripts/playbooks, runbooks, documentation

**Preferred / Bonus:**

* Cisco StarOS Specialist
* NetNumber Specialist
* Nokia CMU Specialist
* NOKIA SRC/NRP certifications: NRS II

**Experience You Would Be Expected To Have**

* Able to deliver significant stakeholder influence to resolve problems. Expected to give technical guidance to others to help resolve issues outside of the domain of the role.
* Acts as a point of contact for technical expertise to advise senior stakeholders, internal and external.
* Help to identify minimum data fields (across all stages) required from both customer and inventory systems from a technical designer perspective
* Identifying dependencies and system integration required to build the work-flow and work with appropriate teams to get the same implemented.
* Expert user of design tools; seeks opportunities to develop new design tools for BT, and for external adoption.
* Makes authoritative recommendations on tools and processes for network platforms and/or customer solutions, where appropriate.
* Able to solve problems typically specific to leading edge high impact and high risk network platforms and/or customer solutions.
* Able to solve complex and unknown problems that may lie outside the domain of the role. Problems may impact a single network platform and/or customer solution supporting multiple services. The most complex problem will be platform wide, impacting multiple services (and include multiple vendors) or cross-portfolio solutions.
* Impact of decisions are specific to the design strategy and/or direction for leading edge high risk and high impact network platforms and/or customer solution.
* Evidence of successful transformation measures – e.g. Network upgrade success rate with minimal customer impact.
* On-time delivery of plans, risk assessments, and recommendations
* Mentors and share knowledge with others.

**BT Group’s Behaviours**
**Customer First**
Prioritize customer needs in every decision and action.
  
  
**Challengers**
Challenge the status quo and bring innovative ideas to life.
  
  
**Committed**
Own outcomes and deliver with integrity.
  
  
**Clear**
Communicate openly and simply, ensuring alignment.
  
  
**Connected**
Collaborate across teams to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Customer Solutions Design Practitioner delivers end-to-end technical designs, ensuring that business requirements are successful translated into deliverable solutions, which meet customer needs whilst considering the impact of those solutions on all technical and business areas.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Captures detailed customer technical requirements and translation to detailed solution design in accordance with design methodologies.
* Executes the technical direction and delivers optimum solution design for customers.
* Reviews and validates both new developments and in-life products and services, ensuring full integration across all aspects.
* Contributes to the improvement of design and delivery capabilities for end-to-end technical solutions.
* Delivers customer solution design engagement and statement of work creation, including any 3rd party deliverables.
* Executes customer migration planning and implementation.
* Supports on impact assessments and design documentation updates.
* Supports all parties throughout the project lifecycle to determine the optimum solution design for customers.
* Resolves solution and service issues, leads root cause analysis, troubleshooting and escalation.
* Undertakes the delivery of performance and process improvements.
* Develops and shares with team knowledge on emerging trends and changes in customer solution design.
* Supports the implementation of ways to improve working processes within the area of customer solution design through data analysis to identify issues and areas of improvements.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
**Our Package**
At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

title: SOC Analyst (L1)
description:

**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Security Managed Services Engineer (L1) is an entry level engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their Firewall infrastructure remain operational through proactively identifying, investigating, and routing the incidents to correct resolver group.
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to ensure zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions and focuses on first-line support for standard and low complexity incidents and service requests.
  
  
The Security Managed Services Engineer (L1) may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* BE/BTech in Electronics/EC/EE/CS/IT Engineering
* At least one security certification such as CCNA Security, CCSA, CEH, CompTIA

**Required Experience:**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in handling security related products & services and preferably SIEM solution.
* Person should have adequate knowledge of security devices like firewalls, IPS, Web Application Firewall, DDOS, EDR, Incident response, SOAR and other security devices.
* Construction of SIEM content required to produce Content Outputs (e.g., filters, active lists, correlation rules, reports, report templates, queries, trends, variables)
* Knowledge of packet level analysis
* Knowledge of networking protocols and technologies and network security
* Sound analytical and troubleshooting skills

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Monitors client infrastructure and solutions.
* Identifies problems and errors prior to or when they occur.
* Routinely identifies common incidents and opportunities for avoidance as well as general opportunities for incident reduction.
* Investigates first line incidents assigned and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Provides telephonic or chat support to clients when required.
* Schedules maintenance activity windows for patching and configuration changes.
* Follows the required handover procedures for shift changes to ensure service continuity.
* Reports and escalates incidents where necessary.
* Ensures the efficient and comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests.
